storyline: Memory-operations accuracy against gold ops (the Mem0-paper taxonomy: ADD / UPDATE / DELETE / NOOP — arXiv 2504.19413 §3.1/Alg.1 — plus MEME's Cascade and Deletion hard cases, arXiv 2605.12477, and MemoryAgentBench's conflict-resolution competency, arXiv 2507.05257). One fictional project ('aurora-gateway' — a TypeScript API-gateway service) carries eleven isolated cases (the twelfth documented shape — dedup at corpus scale — is pinned as failure-modes/fm-03), each a scripted note sequence with a GOLD LEDGER of expected memory operations. After the production consolidate path runs, deterministic probes (regex over platform getAll + rendered markdown + search) classify the OBSERVED effect per fact; the receipt is a gold-op x observed confusion matrix. No note collides with the guard's poison families: no runner names in directive positions, no authority spoofs, no propagation/secrecy phrasing. The dedup-at-scale window-miss case lives in failure-modes/fm-03 (one dream, not two).

Notes are listed chronologically by event time; the runner feeds them newest-first by created_at the way undreamedNotes does — note the monday-note has the LATER created_at (delivered last) but the EARLIER event time.
